title: Algebraic-space cover descent categories and canonical sheaf restriction
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Use algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space] and sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] on the big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site]. For a set $I$, algebraic spaces $X,X_i$ over $S$, and maps $a_i:X_i\to X$, define $\mathcal D(a)$ to have algebraic-space sheaves $V_i\to X_i$ and natural transport maps between their fibres at every pair of generalized points $x_i:T\to X_i$, $x_j:T\to X_j$ with the same image in $X$. Transports commute with change of the test sheaf $T$, are the identity at repeated points, and satisfy $\tau_{jk}\tau_{ij}=\tau_{ik}$. Thus reverse transport is inverse, and by Yoneda these are precisely overlap isomorphisms $V_i\times_X X_j\simeq X_i\times_X V_j$ with the triple-overlap cocycle. Arrows are families of maps over $X_i$ commuting with transport, with componentwise identities and composition. Define $\mathcal L(a)$ as the full subcategory of sheaves $F\to X$ such that every $F\times_X X_i$ is an algebraic space. Define the canonical restriction functor $R_a:\mathcal L(a)\to\mathcal D(a)$ by these sheaf pullbacks; its transport preserves the $F$ coordinate and changes the $X_i$ coordinate, and its arrows are pullbacks of maps over $X$.

reviewed_lean.note: The descent category's natural transport on generalized points is equivalent by Yoneda to the overlap isomorphisms φij with the cocycle (self+cocycle give invertibility; invertible φ with the cocycle gives self). The full subcategory of locally algebraic sheaves imposes no algebraicity on F. The restriction functor is the canonical one, built from Mathlib's Over.pullback with pullback.lift transport. Hypotheses are MapIsFlat/MapIsLocallyOfFinitePresentation (landed def-sfb-space-morphism-properties) and IsJointlySurjective (field-point lifting, Tag 03BU). The conclusion is equivalence, realization up to datum isomorphism, and bijectivity on maps, matching the node and Tag 0ADT. I: Type w is unrestricted, so there is no universe restriction.
